overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission met to consider several license applications, permits, and operational requests. The commission approved a one-day license for an art studio, entertainment and conditional hours requests for a new Irish pub, distillery and winery permits for a local brewery, and a new liquor license for a Mediterranean restaurant.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from the October 22, 2026 meeting.

items.title: Eventham Studios One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for Eventham Studios to serve beer, wine, and malt beverages at a gallery exhibit reception on December 3, 2026.

items.title: Rory O'Connor's Entertainment License and Change of Hours
items.summary: Approved an entertainment license for up to 10 devices and background music, and conditionally approved a change of operating hours pending receipt of a common victualler license.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company Distillery and Winery Permits
items.summary: Approved Section 19E farmer-distillery and Section 19B farmer-winery pouring permits for Medford Brewing Company's expanded product offerings.

items.title: Ultramarinos Liquor License Application
items.summary: Approved a new liquor license for 42 Riverside LLC, doing business as Ultramarinos, for a new restaurant at the former Zam Zam location.
